'''2008 Indiana State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Sunday 27 July 2008 at GAMERZ, 1140 N State Road 135, Greenwood, Indiana, the day after the [[2008 Corellia Regionals]] at the same store.<ref name="sf-20765-299624">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=299624#p299624 The Official Corellia Regionals Thread], davidson07 (Wes Cobb), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (5 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182549/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20765.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Aaron Groth]] received its bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]].<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Organization ==

[[Wes Cobb]] announced the Corellia Regionals and the Indiana state championship as one weekend on 5 May 2008. The state championship was six games of constructed with match play between the top two players, a $10 entry fee and registration from noon, with the first game at 12:30 pm; prizes were glass, and the winner could pick from the Players Committee's league prize support. Decklists were required, and the event was held in conjunction with the Louisville/Indy SWCCG league.<ref name="sf-20765-299624" /> After Paul Brothers, the announced tournament director, backed out, a player wrote on 3 July that the state championship would use the three-judge system.<ref name="sf-20765-312186">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=312186#p312186 The Official Corellia Regionals Thread], retwin316, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (3 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125182549/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t20765.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' GAMERZ, 1140 N State Road 135, Greenwood, Indiana<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Dates:''' 27 July 2008<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Time:''' registration from 12:00 noon, first game at 12:30 pm<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Format:''' constructed, six games, with match play between the top two; decklists required<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-20765-299624" />
* '''Judges:''' three-judge system<ref name="sf-20765-312186" />
* '''Day 2 bye:''' [[Aaron Groth]]<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
